title: Initial main statement setup
statement: Let $W$ be a word width, let $lim$ be a resource limit, let $P$ be a program, let $p_0$ be a procedure index, and let $dec$ be a Boolean. Suppose the word width fits the limits, the dispatcher position determined by $P$ and $dec$, and the stack capacity determined by $P$ and $lim$. For every state $σ$ bounded by $lim$ and every word memory $m$ related to $σ$ at stack position $4$, the statement that calls procedure $p_0$ with the first two variables as arguments satisfies the starting conditions at depth $0$, code position $4$, and stack position $4$.
hypotheses_covered: word width, resource limits, program, procedure index, and Boolean parameter
memory related to the state at the main-frame stack position
replaced:

position for the setting determined by these data, the main statement at procedure index
